title: No winners of major lotto games as Ultra Lotto prize reaches P384.9 million
summary: There were no winners of either of the two major lotto games played on Sunday, October 11, 2026, as one of the jackpots neared P385 billion.

blocks.text: There were no winners of either of the two major lotto games played on Sunday, October 11, 2026, as one of the jackpots neared P385 billion.
No bettor chose the winning combination of 37-33-14-06-35-41 for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot, which has risen to P384,920,118.91.
There was also no winner of the Superlotto 6/49 game, with no bettors choosing the numbers 13-22-40-34-04-41 for the prize of P43,757,630.79.
